thought.text: The main frontend failed at the nginx stage: `/app/mfe-ewm/dist-injector` wasn't produced. Let me find why the mfe-ewm build step failed:

reasoning_content:
The frontend's main build is failing at stage 2: it can't find `/app/mfe-ewm/dist-injector`. Let's take a look: the Dockerfile's build step is running `npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-ewm & npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-ewm &` in parallel. It's possible that the mfe-ewm injector build failed (or was skipped). Let's check the build step logs for mfe-ewm.

Also, the reason the mfe-ewm/mfe-fp/mfe-ws/shell logs are empty is that the orchestrator was killed before wave B completed (they were supposed to run after the main frontend). The orchestrator has already been terminated, so we need to build them manually.

Let's check the frontend build logs for the mfe-ewm build step.

action.command: cd /workspace/.build-logs && grep -n 'mfe-ewm' frontend.log | head -20; echo ====; awk '/#26 \[builder 18.21\]/,/#26 DONE|ERROR/' frontend.log 2>/dev/null | grep -n 'error\|Error\|mfe-ewm\|injector' | head -20
